chapter: Fletcher Henderson and forming his own band
title: Forming his first band as a rehearsal group
summary: After the Arcadia band, Carter formed a rehearsal band with Cozy Cole, Sid Catlett, Dickie Wells and Chu Berry and recorded in 1932.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Well, it must have been around that time then, that you began to think about the possibility of your forming a band yourself.
I guess I had it in my mind, because I had had the band ... oh, you mean at the time when I was with Billy Fowler and was asked to come join Fletcher?
Yeah. No ... for a short time. I mean after that.
You mean when I was asked to come as a regular member?
Right. That's what I meant.
Was that ... let's see, I'm trying to remember -- was that before or after I had the band at the Arcadia?
It was after.
After?
Yes.
Yes, well, then I had already had a band for a short while.
Right. But once you had it for a short while, obviously, you had the idea -- it was working around inside you all of the time.
Yes.
Once that comes to you, you never really stop it.
That sweet smell of failure.
I'll have to remember that!
Well, you had this idea that you wanted to form a band, and you finally formed one, I guess, in perhaps '32 or '33.
Or thereabouts.
Right. Right. And what ...
As you have made me realize.
Yes. What kind of ... or did you have dates right off or was it a band that you formed with the idea of doing whatever you could -- it wasn't formed to sign a contract or to do something?
No, it was hoping to be able to do something after getting the band together, and it was really, essentially, a rehearsal band, you know?
Uh huh.
I had people in it like Cozy Cole, Big Sid Catlett, Dickie Wells, Chu Chew Berry.
Right.
And, oh, so many wonderful players.
Some very good ones.
Yes.
Very good men.
Sure.
And you recorded with that band in June, I think, according to what I have here, June of 1932, I believe.
Yes.
But they didn't at that time -- you had not regular dates ...
Employment.
Employment at the moment, and some of the other musicians you had at various times with this group then were Louie Bacon, Frankie Newton and Dickie Wells.
Right.
So, how did Teddy Wilson join -- it was this group that Teddy Wilson joined when he came to New York?
